name: I've Met a Mermaid in an Onsen
source:
Miki and Rin are average high school catgirls, who discover, that their favourite café ran out of milk.  Their quest to find some brings them to a hot spring, where they make a special encounter…

[From [url=https://leo-prikler.itch.io/i-ve-met-a-mermaid-in-an-onsen]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
三木和凛是普通的高中猫女，她们发现她们最喜欢的咖啡馆没有牛奶了。为了寻找一些东西，他们来到了一个温泉，在那里他们发生了一次特殊的邂逅……

[来自[url=https://leo-prikler.itch.io/i-ve-met-a-mermaid-in-an-onsen]itch.io[/url]]
